englishTranslation: Quảng-style turmeric noodles with shrimp and pork
atAGlance: Mì Quảng tôm thịt is the shrimp-and-pork version of Quảng-style turmeric noodles, with herbs, peanuts, rice cracker, and just enough broth to stain the noodles golden.
whatItIs: Mì Quảng tôm thịt is a central Vietnamese turmeric-noodle bowl with shrimp, pork, herbs, peanuts, rice crackers, and a shallow yellow broth. The broth seasons the noodles instead of filling the bowl.
howToEnjoy: Crack the rice cracker into the bowl, mix the herbs and peanuts through, and let the shallow turmeric broth coat the noodles. Add lime or chili after tasting the broth.
howLocalsOrder: Order mì Quảng tôm thịt when you want the classic shrimp-and-pork version. Ask for less chili or no peanuts before mixing, but expect only a small amount of broth.
worthKnowing: Mì Quảng is a signature of Quảng Nam and Đà Nẵng food culture; the “almost dry” broth level is intentional.
goodToKnow: This commonly includes both shellfish and pork. Ask before ordering if either one matters.
travelerCaution: Contains shrimp, pork, and often peanuts.
